categories.main_business_segments: Amano Corporation operates two main business segments: the Time Information System business and the Environmental System business. The Time Information System segment includes products such as time recorders, attendance management systems, payroll systems, and parking management systems. The Environmental System segment covers dust collectors, air conveyance systems, deodorization systems, cleaning equipment, and electrolyzed water generators.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in time management, access control, and parking systems, integrating hardware with software and cloud-based solutions. In the environmental segment, Amano utilizes advanced filtration, air purification, and cleaning robotics, with ongoing development in IoT, AI, and automation. Manufacturing emphasizes quality, reliability, and adaptability to customer needs, with both in-house production and global R&D collaboration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Amano serves a wide range of customers including corporations, public institutions, hospitals, educational organizations, and facility managers. Its main end markets are office buildings, factories, commercial facilities, parking operators, and industrial plants, with solutions tailored for both large-scale enterprises and SMEs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in Japan, North America (primarily the US and Canada), Europe (notably Belgium, France, and Spain), and Asia (including China, Korea, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Vietnam). Overseas sales account for nearly half of total revenue, reflecting a well-established international network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Amano is primarily positioned as a midstream to downstream player, manufacturing finished products and systems, and providing integrated solutions and services directly to end users and facility operators. It also offers maintenance, engineering, and operational outsourcing services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Amano is focused on expanding its software, cloud, and data-driven services, promoting digital transformation (DX) across its businesses. R&D priorities include enhancing cloud-based solutions, AI and IoT integration, robotics for cleaning, and developing new products for emerging needs such as cashless and ticketless parking. The company also emphasizes sustainability, human capital development, and global expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through the sale of hardware products, software licenses, cloud and SaaS subscriptions, maintenance contracts, and operational outsourcing (such as parking management and cleaning services). Amano is also expanding its stock-type (recurring) business through cloud and service offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Amano holds leading market shares in Japan and significant positions in overseas markets for time management and parking systems. Key competitors include domestic and international firms in time management, access control, parking systems, and industrial environmental equipment, such as Seiko, Omron, and various global cleaning equipment manufacturers. Amano differentiates itself through integrated solutions and a strong service network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Amano reported consolidated sales of 175.4 billion yen, operating profit of 23.0 billion yen, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 17.8 billion yen, with a workforce of 5,541 employees. The company has demonstrated robust growth, with double-digit revenue and profit increases year-over-year, and targets further expansion to 180 billion yen in sales and 24.5 billion yen in operating profit by FY2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Amano emphasizes comprehensive, integrated solutions that combine hardware, software, and cloud services, enabling customers to optimize workforce management, facility operations, and environmental quality. Its strengths lie in reliability, technological innovation, robust after-sales support, and the ability to address both operational efficiency and sustainability needs for diverse industries.
